Kit summary

Arrow of DawnBasic
Deals 160% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to reduce their Effect RES by 50% for 2 turns.
God of Archery's ArrivalActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 2 stages of 100% ATK DMG to a single enemy. The first stage has a 90% chance to reduce the target's DEF by 60% for 2 turns, and the second stage has a 90% chance to reduce the target's Tenacity by 60% for 2 turns.
Ancestral Bow Lv.3Hoff casts [God of Archery's Arrival] one more time on the first target inflicted with [Hunting] at the beginning of each wave.
Hunting GroovePassiveExclusive Lv.1
Inflicts [Hunting] on a random enemy at the beginning of each wave. Restores the killer's HP by 30% of Max HP when the target under [Hunting] status is killed, and the killer acts immediately. Afterward, Hoff inflicts [Hunting] on a random enemy again.
Ancestral Bow Lv.1Hunting Groove: Inflicts [Hunting] on the enemy with the highest ATK instead. Increases all allies' ATK by 40% for 2 turns when the enemy target under [Hunting] status is killed.
Squall of ArrowsActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 2 stages of 100% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 80% chance to inflict [HP Burning] for 2 turns.
Ancestral Bow Lv.2Hoff inflicts [Feebleness I] on all enemies for 2 turns before casting Squall of Arrows.
